_readme: HOMEPAGE CONTENT. 'intro' paragraphs appear under your name. 'themes' are the research themes. 'featuredProject' must match a slug in content/projects/.
intro: I study how attention and inhibitory control are affected by emotional experience, and how early adversity is carried forward into cognitive functioning. My work is experimental and quantitative — reaction-time paradigms, questionnaires and eye-tracking.
I am an undergraduate psychology researcher at Ashoka University, and have worked in developmental psychopathology, clinical psychology and comparative cognition.
_themes: Three or four research themes. Keep each description to one or two sentences.

themes.title: Cognitive Control
themes.text: Inhibitory control and attentional control: how people withhold a prepared response, and how much that ability depends on what else is competing for attention.

themes.title: Childhood Adversity
themes.text: Whether emotional abuse and emotional neglect relate to cognitive functioning in different ways, rather than as a single cumulative score.

themes.title: Clinical & Developmental Psychology
themes.text: Psychological distress, mental health assessment, and the developmental pathways that lead to them.

themes.title: Measurement
themes.text: Getting at these constructs properly: adapting instruments across cultures, and prevalidating stimuli and items before they go into a study.
